checked_obligation: Verify that the stated choice witnesses the negation of uniform convergence to the necessary pointwise limit f.
reason: By the closed predecessor, f(x)=0 for every x<1. Fix any ε with 0<ε<1. For every N∈Z_+, x=ε^{1/N} lies in (0,1), so f(x)=0 and |f_N(x)-f(x)|=x^N=ε. Taking n=N≥N gives, for every N, a point where the error is at least ε, which is exactly a witness to failure of uniform convergence. The listed group-theoretic rules are inapplicable.
